summary: Define the attention budget window in docs/st3/priority.md: rolling 7 days per mission and person, with one native person ask as the unit; delegated child runs count for the ancestor mission. The previously added attention request report measures this window; it is a report only, with no admission or enforcement, and is not fleet-complete.

replay.detail: Documentation only; no changes to claim replay or run-lineage interpretation.

schema.detail: No durable claim or table changes.

rules.detail: Clarifies that Store::attention_request_count measures the documented attention budget window, correcting the earlier description that it was not a budget window. No attention declaration, admission or enforcement is introduced.

compatibility.detail: No Rust API, CLI, HTTP or wire API changes.
